hook.en: A carpenter has a saw, a plane and a chisel for different jobs. An analyst has five main tools: comparative statements, common size statements, trend analysis, ratio analysis and cash flow analysis.

body.en: Horizontal (dynamic) analysis compares figures of several years, e.g. comparative statements and trend analysis. Vertical (static) analysis studies the relationship of items within one year, e.g. common size statements. Comparisons can be intra-firm (same firm over time) or inter-firm (between firms).
body.kn: ಸಮತಲ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಲಂಬ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಒಂದೇ ವರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ತುಲನಾತ್ಮಕ ತಃಖ್ತೆ ಸಮತಲ; ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆ ಲಂಬ.

narration.en: Horizontal analysis compares several years; vertical analysis studies one year. Comparative statements are horizontal; common size statements are vertical.
narration.kn: ಸಮತಲ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಲಂಬ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಒಂದೇ ವರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ತುಲನಾತ್ಮಕ ತಃಖ್ತೆ ಸಮತಲ; ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆ ಲಂಬ.

title.en: On the board: Tools of analysis

narration.en: Analysis goes two ways: across years, called horizontal, or within one year, called vertical.

say.en: Analysis goes two ways: across years, called horizontal, or within one year, called vertical.
Trend analysis: take the base year as one hundred. Revenue four lakh becomes one hundred.
Then divide each later year by the base and multiply by one hundred.

body.en: Comparative statements show absolute and percentage changes over years. Common size statements express each item as a percentage of a common base. Trend analysis takes a base year as 100 and expresses later years as index numbers. Ratio analysis relates two figures to judge liquidity, solvency, activity and profitability. Cash flow analysis studies inflows and outflows of cash.
body.kn: ಐದು ಸಾಧನಗಳು: ತುಲನಾತ್ಮಕ ತಃಖ್ತೆ, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗಾತ್ರದ ತಃಖ್ತೆ, ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ, ಅನುಪಾತ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ, ನಗದು ಹರಿವಿನ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ. ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಶೇಕಡಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಲ ವರ್ಷ ನೂರು.

caption.en: Enter revenue for three years. The first year is the base (100); bars show each year as a trend percentage.

narration.en: Trend percentages remove the size of the figures and show only the direction and speed of change.

tryThis.en: Make year 3 smaller than the base: what does a trend below 100 mean?
Change the base year figure: why do all the bars move?

problem.en: Revenue from operations of Hemavati Ltd.: 2022-23 ₹4,00,000 (base); 2023-24 ₹4,40,000; 2024-25 ₹5,20,000. Compute trend percentages.
